Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic phosphoproteomics workflow using TiO2 enrichment and DDA-LFQ. Site localization was specifically addressed using the ptmRS node in Proteome Discoverer.

scope: For MS-based phosphoproteomics of D6R, HEK293 cells stably expressing the D6R were grown at a confluency of ~70%.
The pellets were then treated with 6 M Gn-HCL/0.1 M Tris (pH 8.5) plus phosphatase inhibitors and resuspended well.
The lysate was then boiled at 95°C for 10 min, followed by sonication for breaking the nucleic acids and reducing the viscosity of slimy material.

We generated the proteolytic fragments by using trypsin digestion of cellular lysate from both conditions followed by TiO2-based phospho-peptide enrichment and detection of phospho-peptides by using liquid chromatography-tandem MS (LC-MS/MS).

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The MS-based phosphoproteomics was performed on total cellular lysates from HEK293 cells. While TiO2 was used for phosphopeptide enrichment, this is a post-digestion peptide-level enrichment and does not constitute a subcellular fractionation of the starting material.
